The report now marks an item `REORDER` as soon as what's on hand is less than 6 days of its average daily sales. I ran it against your current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, needs about 14 to cover 6 days) and oat milk (30 on hand, needs 45) are the two it catches that the old report showed as fine.

- **Changing the supplier:** the 6 is `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` near the top of `stock_report.py`, just under the imports.
- **Empty shelves:** items at zero still show `OUT`, so you can tell "already empty" apart from "order now".
- **Exact boundary:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock left shows `ok`, since it runs out just as the delivery lands. If you'd rather have a cushion, bump the number to 7.
